item.text:
**Bottom line**
- **Mixed but leaning no.** In 2024 Abiy Ahmed sometimes used accurate, non-escalatory public language, especially on Somalia and the IMF program. But the stronger pattern is **selective truthfulness and repeated denial/minimization of abuses**, plus delegitimizing rhetoric toward oversight bodies. Direct evidence about courts is sparse; most usable material is from parliament speeches, press responses, and fact checks.

| Side | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port | Associated Press | 2024-02-06 | https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | Abiy told lawmakers Ethiopia had no intention of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial; that is one of the clearest 2024 examples of straightforward public de-escalation. | 7B.1 |
| Positive | Ethiopia Has No Intention of Harming Somalia in Any Way: PM Abiy | ENA English | 2024-02-06 | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_3975603 | Official transcript says Abiy denied harmful intent toward Somalia, said sea access should be handled as mutual benefit, and pointed to Somali troop training as evidence against conflict intent. | 7B.1 |
| Positive | Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port | Associated Press | 2024-02-06 | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | AP reported Abiy also reassured Egypt on the Nile dam, which supports a limited reading of him trying to cool a live regional crisis rather than inflame it. | 7B.1 |
| Positive | IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia | IMF | 2024-07-29 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr | Abiy told parliament IMF negotiations were in the final stage; the IMF approved the program three weeks later, which is at least consistent with a truthful status update on that issue. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation | Associated Press | 2024-02-15 | https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/ | Ethiopian officials denied Merawi massacre allegations while independent monitors said at least 45 civilians were killed; this is strong evidence of denial in the face of serious contrary reporting. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopia: Authorities Suspend Three Rights Groups | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups | HRW said Abiy publicly praised reforms like media freedom and NGO registration while the government kept cracking down on rights groups, suggesting a gap between rhetoric and actual conduct. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups | Human Rights Watch | 2024-06-18 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups | Rights groups reported security and intelligence personnel followed and intimidated human-rights workers; that undercuts any claim that the government was being candid about its treatment of watchdogs. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopia: A secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels | Reuters via EHRC | 2024-02-27 | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | Reuters, via the EHRC, reported a secret “Koree Nageenyaa” committee interfering in justice and linked to widespread violations, which implies opaque coercive governance rather than transparent truth-telling to courts or the public. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopian leader’s speech did not include ‘stern warning’ to Somalia and Egypt | AFP Fact Check | 2024-09-04 | https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.36FG9HB | AFP showed a viral clip alleging a 2024 threat to Somalia and Egypt was actually old Tigray footage; this does not prove Abiy lied, but it shows how his speeches were used in ways that detached them from context. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Ethiopian leader’s remarks about alleged coup plotters taken out of context | AFP Fact Check | 2024-07-09 | https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.363E7V8 | AFP said a viral clip overstated Abiy’s July 4 parliamentary remarks about coup plotters; he warned dissidents abroad, but did not say a coup had been thwarted. | 7B.1 |

**Assessment**
- The strongest positive evidence is limited to **specific statements** that were later consistent with events or agreements.
- The strongest negative evidence is broader: **denials of alleged atrocities, suppression of scrutiny, and opaque security structures**.
- I did **not** find strong direct evidence on courtroom truthfulness in 2024; the record is mostly about public statements, parliament, and responses to allegations.
